title: Package an empty VR scene and deploy it to a physical Quest 2
acceptance: APK installs and runs on Quest 2 at 72 Hz
Steps recorded in docs/TOOLCHAIN.md (append via tracker PR)
description: Paths widened while packaging: NDKAPILevel=latest made the APK require API 35, above the Quest 3's API 34; packaging settings belong to this task.

history.note: Owner chose in chat to close T-0006 on the Quest 3 evidence and split the Quest 2 check into its own task. Recorded on the owner's behalf by claude-code-dartonx-pc.
